integration_issues.issue: Playwright timing artifact: clicking [data-testid=adam-generate-roadmap] while previous chat stream still `busy=true` no-ops (button disabled attribute is on). Backend /api/adam/roadmap works end-to-end (verified by pytest, returns valid markdown with Diagnosis+Days 1-30 sections in ~30s). Not a functional bug — recommend main agent verify manually by waiting for chat stream to finish before clicking roadmap.

critical_code_review_comments: auth.py:106 raises 403 with a body detail — correct behavior (non-allowlisted authenticated users get 403 not 401). Verified.
blogs.py:184 view increment uses $inc atomically then returns doc['views']+1 (locally added) — correct.
blogs.py:192 duplicate slug generation appends 5-char hex — safe. Verified via pytest.

blogs.py:220 update_blog: BlogUpdate uses Pydantic model, so `author` is already a dict via model_dump(exclude_unset). The `hasattr(update['author'], 'model_dump')` check is a no-op safeguard — harmless.

adam_intel.py:196-204 SSE frames: each TextDelta chunk is split on 
 into multiple `data:` lines terminated by a single blank `
` — frontend api.js correctly rejoins with 
. Verified via chat stream test.
AdamDashboard uses window.confirm for delete — works with page.on('dialog') but not testable via cypress-style UI; consider a shadcn AlertDialog in future.
api.js uses credentials:'include' universally — required for HttpOnly session cookie. Correct.
AdminPanel.jsx line 17: authState initial value depends on location.state?.user for direct navigation from AuthCallback — good synchronous handoff.
